text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, amore. Tomorrow morning, I'll come 
pick you up at your room.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
See you tomorrow, then. —Let's make it a 
fun day.

I impulsively agreed to the sudden 
proposal. I don't have any other plans, so 
it's fine, but if I remember correctly, 
tomorrow is—

"...The next day. While waiting at the 
time Sounds of Earth had appointed—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Buon San Valentino. First, please take 
this.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you were surprised. I've 
prepared a vase as well, so please do put 
them on display.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pouring one's feelings into chocolate. 
That is the Valentine's Day tradition here 
in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: However— for me, today is different.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think that today is a day for 
two close people to deepen their bond even 
further.

"Indeed, I've heard that Valentine's Day 
traditions vary depending on the country."

Sounds of Earth is well-versed in overseas 
customs. Just as I was thinking that 
presenting a bouquet must be one of those 
common traditions—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are unmistakably an object of 
"love."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So today, I want to make this our 
anniversary to deepen that "love."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Don't you agree, Trainer?

—Whispered right into my ear, my heart 
skips a beat, and Sounds of Earth takes my 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To where “Love” calls!

And so, the "Day of Love" began, and it 
was nothing short of sheer sweetness—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How beautiful! Behold the flowers 
sparkling in the morning dew—!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Can you feel those innocent, fresh 
whispers of someone who has only just 
awakened?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, do you know the reason why 
they bloom in such a variety of colors, 
Direttore?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, do you know the reason why 
they bloom in such a variety of colors, 
Direttrice?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Why, that's to bring out the radiant 
beauty of your eyes as they reflect the 
flowers!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That said—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just don't forget to always keep me 
reflected in some corner of your mind, my 
beloved?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
May I have your hand, amore? We wouldn't 
want you to stumble, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Do not hold back. Would you grant this 
servant of love the honor of taking your 
hand?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, your face is red.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Did the breeze make you cold? Perhaps we 
should skip the terrace and find a table 
inside—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us go, my treasure. Let us share 
an intimate moment together—

Telling me to wait here for a bit, Sounds 
of Earth went off to look for a shop, but—

Sounds of Earth never hides his passion, 
but today his display of affection is even 
more intense than usual.

"If I simply allow myself to be escorted 
like this, I feel I'll fail as an adult, 
and above all, as a mentor."
choice_data_list:
(I need to think of something to give in 
return—alright!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Why is it that precious time passes by in 
the blink of an eye?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To think that even the passion burning in 
my chest cannot stop the hands of the 
clock.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that is precisely why, my amore. At 
the end of this "Day of Love," allow me to 
bestow a special gift upon you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're not hiding your anticipation 
very well, my beloved other half.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. I've already gotten permission 
to play. So don't worry, just close your 
eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And I want you to feel the feelings I 
dedicate to you—"

...The melody began with a pizzicato that 
carried the subtle scent of water.

A sound like morning dew rolling over 
flower petals. Followed by a gentle 
legato, like a soft breeze swaying the 
blossoms.

As the melody unfolds, the cheerful 
martellato notes mingle together like 
sparkling sunlight.

Perhaps the increasingly sweet, 
double-stopped notes are an expression of 
the time we spent snuggled close together 
all day...
(Yay, *clap clap clap*)

Sounds of Earth brought his performance to 
a close, leaving behind a touch of 
romantic resonance.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Grazie. Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How is it, my conductor? Did you like the 
gift?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How is it, my conductor? Did you like the 
gift?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The title was, indeed—"Day of Love".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Forgive me for such an unpolished 
improvisation. I simply wished to engrave 
this day even deeper into your heart."
choice_data_list:
Is that why you were acting like that all 
day...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes... In order to offer you my true love 
in the form of music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"How was that, did you enjoy it? My 
heart."
choice_data_list: That was amazing! I was truly moved!
That was amazing! I was truly moved!

text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth always conveys his 
feelings straight from the heart, so I 
conveyed mine straight back to him. And 
then—
choice_data_list:
So consider this a token of my 
appreciation!

So consider this a token of my 
appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Huh—?

I handed Sounds of Earth the present I had 
bought earlier when we split up at the 
department store.

Sometimes, just constantly receiving 
things feels unseemly. More than that, 
however, I wanted to properly convey that 
I also had feelings of my own.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This logo... Could it be chocolate? I see. 
So you're...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mamma mia...! To think such joy could 
exist!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stand around! I need to turn 
this joy into a melody right away!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you will play along with me, 
won't you, amore? The coda to our "Day of 
Love"!

Spurred by Sounds of Earth's words, guests 
at the observation deck gathered, eager 
for the performance to continue.

The brilliant melody shifted through key 
after key, resonating endlessly—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
We can't just stand around! Hurry, we need 
to head somewhere we can be alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, my burning passion would end up 
melting this precious gift.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Before that happens... you'll feed me, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Directly from your hands, the sweet taste 
of this love—
